nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances in ERC20.
Private nested mapping of spender allowances in ERC20.
Private total supply counter in ERC20.
Token name string set once in constructor.
Token symbol string set once in constructor.
Token decimals, default 18.
Owner address in Ownable, gates onlyOwner functions.
_total = 1700000, the initial mint multiplier in Passive_Income_Bot.
Constructor of Passive_Income_Bot; mints initial supply to msg.sender.
Internal _mint: increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal _transfer: moves balances between accounts and fires hook.
Internal _burn: decreases balance and total supply.
Internal _approve: writes the _allowances mapping.
Public transferFrom; moves tokens and decrements allowance.
Public approve; sets allowance for _msgSender().
Public increaseAllowance using SafeMath add.
Public decreaseAllowance using SafeMath sub.
Ownable transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner.
Ownable renounceOwnership guarded by onlyOwner.
View returning the current owner address.
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender.
Virtual hook invoked before any token transfer/mint/burn.
msg.sender is attacker-controlled and used for minting, allowance and ownership checks.
Arithmetic multiplication _total.mul(10 ** 18) executed in the constructor.
account parameter of _mint, receives minted tokens.
amount parameter of _mint, value added to supply and balance.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, written into _owner.
Local msgSender in Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().
Ownable constructor; assigns deployer as initial owner.

edges.reason: _total state variable is read by the multiplication _total.mul(10 ** 18).
Result of the multiplication is passed as the amount argument to _mint.
Passive_Income_Bot constructor performs the SafeMath multiplication.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in the constructor.
Constructor invokes internal _mint to create initial supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath add.
_mint increases the _balances entry of the recipient.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping updated by _mint.
amount parameter is added to balance and total supply inside _mint.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
msgSender local variable drives the owner initialization inside the Ownable constructor.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner to the deployer.
msg.sender flows through _msgSender into the Ownable constructor.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
transfer delegates to internal _transfer.
msg.sender is used as the sender via _msgSender in transfer.
transfer calls _msgSender to obtain the caller.
_transfer subtracts and adds entries in the _balances mapping.
_burn subtracts from the _balances mapping via SafeMath.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership reads the _owner state variable in the onlyOwner check.
transferOwnership writes the new address into _owner.
onlyOwner checks the caller in renounceOwnership.
renounceOwnership reads _owner for the onlyOwner guard and the event.
renounceOwnership resets _owner to the zero address.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only exists to index balances inside _mint; it should be folded into the _mint core node.
The amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath additions inside _mint; merge it into the _mint core node.
The newOwner parameter only flows into the _owner assignment of transferOwnership; merge it into that core function.
The msgSender local variable is only used to initialize the owner in the Ownable constructor; merge it into that core constructor node.
